name: net_session_browser_dialog_get_message_map
description: NetSessionBrowserDialog::GetMessageMap returns the dialog's MFC message map with the recovered provider, create, timer, destroy, and help handlers. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The smoke verifies the map structure and handler slots, while the provider-owned CDialog base map remains an MFC42 boundary.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41afd0 validates the getter as mov eax, &g_NetSessionBrowserDialog_MessageMap; ret, with no direct callees or this-pointer use.

Binary Ninja data at 0x4cfbd0 validates the base message-map thunk pointer and six 24-byte entries: WM_COMMAND/CBN_SELCHANGE id 1114 to ConnectSelectedProvider, WM_COMMAND/BN_CLICKED id 1030 to OnCreateSession, WM_TIMER to OnTimer with signature 13, WM_DESTROY to OnDestroy, WM_COMMAND/BN_CLICKED id 1029 to OnHelpDocs, and the all-zero sentinel.

The native smoke verifies GetMessageMap returns NetSessionBrowserDialog::messageMap, the base-map callback resolves through the MFC42 CDialog provider boundary, and every recovered entry field and member-function slot matches the source handlers.
